actions_now: Apply Bacillus thuringiensis (2.0 g/L) or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4 g/L into leaf whorls.
Direct the spray nozzle straight down into the central whorl of each plant.
prevention: Intercrop maize with legume crops (e.g. cowpea, pigeonpea, or desmodium).
Synchronize planting dates within the farming community.
Conserve natural predators such as predatory stink bugs, earwigs, and trichogramma egg parasitoids.
Apply dry sand/sawdust mixed with lime or ash into whorls to kill early instar larvae physically.
text: Diagnosis: Pest - Fall Armyworm. Severity: Moderate. Immediate action: Apply Bacillus thuringiensis (2.0 g/L) or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4 g/L into leaf whorls.
